Beautifully decorated. Safe/Clean/NICE modern accommodations. Spacious with all linens, towels, toiletries, snacks provided & fully stocked kitchen! You'll have everything you need to enjoy your stay on the river in Downtown Nashville.  Free WiFi
Free covered parking for ALL vehicles!
2 Bedrooms/2 full bathrooms and 2 large walk in closets for plenty of storage. Large vanities, 2 showers,

Use the laundry facility, workout facility & outdoor pool.  
I am always available anytime during your stay.
This location is an awesome location with plenty of space to enjoy the river & my place. Free covered parking for ALL vehicles, unlike most downtown rentals.

 I look forward to hosting your group & making the most memorable experience during your stay in Nashville. You'll wanna come back soon!!

Guest access
Access to the entire place.

Other things to note
PERFECT location.  Close to all interstates.  I try to provide everything possible during your stay at my place.  Ironing Boards/Iron, Clothes Steamer/Blow dryers & curling irons.  Plenty of towels, luxury linens.  Fully stocked kitchen.  Fully stocked bathrooms.  Just come to Nashville, I know you'll love my place.  The views of the river are delightful.  I have another property at the same location if you are needing more than one place!
